**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 7.2, p0027).**

- **Direction check:** § 7.2 runs *against* us — Redwood must offer Silverline terms no less favourable than the best terms it gives any other technology supplier. This is a Customer-side MFN, not Vendor-granted best pricing.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** no defined product, no 12-month limit, no reasonable-comparison carve-outs — an open-ended obligation to extend better third-party terms, which is walk-away territory under the rule.
- **Internal conflict:** § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge that Customer has made "no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment," so § 7.2 is inconsistent with the rest of the bargain.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** delete § 7.2 in full, reaching the preferred position; nothing in the edit touches any MFN in our favour.
